list_stats.row_kind_note: by_row_kind counts every row once (gap_family=1, local_duplicate_reconciliation=12, new_compound=7, roster_gap=1). non_new_rows_excluding_family_gaps=13 is the local_rejections set: every row with is_new_compound=no except the family-gap placeholder. It therefore also counts the roster_gap row(s) (succinonitrile), which are not local_duplicate_reconciliation rows (that count is 12).

local_rejections.note: compounds that Round 3 surfaced but the local panel already covers; they are explicitly marked in the list as in_local_*=yes and are never counted as new

round3_reconciliation.leads_not_landing_reason: lead resolved to no compound and its target class is off-target, so it is not a coverage candidate at all

pre_registered_rules.priority_rule: P1 = new compound AND not noise-vetoed AND round3 target class is core AND an epsilon clue exists; P2 = same but core or adjacent; otherwise P3. Local compounds are never promoted.
pre_registered_rules.action_rule: drop if already covered or noise-vetoed; lead-only if off-target or no epsilon clue; read-fulltext if the OA full text is reachable; otherwise human.
pre_registered_rules.evidence_rule: review cue in title/venue -> review; a stated epsilon number, or a measurement verb attached to the epsilon prose -> first-hand measurement; prose-only clue -> compilation restatement; no clue at all -> no epsilon clue

trace_scan_scope.rule: a local trace requires a file that git tracks (git ls-files) and that sits in a declared curated root; the week-scoped scratch area and any underscore-prefixed private basename are excluded, because a compound appearing in an ad-hoc dump or a throwaway rerun says nothing about what the project actually knows
trace_scan_scope.tracked_files_are_the_rule: the candidate list is the intersection of git ls-files and the declared curated roots, so the published list is a function of the version-control contents and reproduces in a clean clone; ignore status is never consulted
trace_scan_scope.untracked_files_are_excluded: any curated-root file that git does not track contributes nothing, so an uncommitted download cache such as data/external/g1plus/pubchem/kpi_shortlist_identity/108-32-7.json can never be quoted as a trace token in a clean clone
trace_scan_scope.restricted_exception_rule: data/restricted/ is a local-only cross-check mirror kept out of the repository on purpose; its files may contribute a trace, but the census counts them apart and every row they touch keeps local_trace_restricted=yes
trace_scan_scope.restricted_exception_is_not_reproducible: data/restricted/ is local-only by design and is NOT part of a clean clone （本机专属、不在干净 clone 内）: a row that only cites restricted files cannot be reproduced from a fresh checkout, so it is flagged local_trace_restricted=yes and counted apart
trace_scan_scope.default_deny: anything under data/ that is neither a declared curated root nor a curated one-level table is rejected, so a new scratch tree is excluded by default
scratch_trees_confirmed: data/interim/ is the only scratch tree under data/

the other git-ignored trees (data/external/g1plus/, data/raw/ and the ignored probe outputs under data/processed/) are download caches: git tracks nothing there, so they cannot contribute, and data/restricted/ contributes only through the declared exception

trace_scan_census.rule: a trace requires a file that git tracks (git ls-files) and that sits in a declared curated root; the sole exception is the local-only data/restricted/ mirror, which is counted separately and keeps local_trace_restricted=yes
trace_scan_census.path_list_sha256_rule: sha256 of the newline-joined, sorted union of tracked candidates and restricted local-only candidates (repo-relative, forward slashes, no trailing newline)
trace_scan_census.restricted_local_only_caveat: data/restricted/ is local-only by design and is NOT part of a clean clone （本机专属、不在干净 clone 内）: a row that only cites restricted files cannot be reproduced from a fresh checkout, so it is flagged local_trace_restricted=yes and counted apart
trace_scan_census.untracked_files_are_excluded: any curated-root file that git does not track contributes nothing, so an uncommitted download cache such as data/external/g1plus/pubchem/kpi_shortlist_identity/108-32-7.json can never be quoted as project knowledge in a clean clone

restricted_values_contract.note: a local_trace_restricted=yes row means the compound is named in a file under data/restricted/, so it must be resolved through the restricted-crosscheck route rather than by acquiring new data; the probe records the file path and nothing else

honesty_boundaries: v0 is a lead list, not a dataset: it writes no observation into data/ and derives no feature
OA reachability is not an epsilon value: 1 of 37 leads carries a number, 22 carry prose only
database-coverage returns are diminishing: 13 of 20 Round-3 compounds are already local
